name: awesome-black-friday-for-developers (tushargugnani)
accepts: Software, design tools, UI kits, courses and books that developers or designers pay for. Categories: developer-tools, laravel-php, design, ui-kits, courses, books, starter-kits, mobile, hosting. Mac apps for visual work are listed. The same list feeds https://blackfridaydeals.dev.
how_to_submit: Pull request adding exactly one entry to deals/<year>.yaml, then run `python3 scripts/validate.py` and `python3 scripts/build_readme.py` and commit both the YAML and the regenerated README. Pull request title: Add <Product>.
entry_format: YAML list item with name, url (https), category, offer, description (one sentence, 180 characters max).
rules: The product must have been publicly available for at least six months, or come from a company people already know. Pull requests for domains registered in August or September 2026 were closed in November 2026.
A pricing page or a clear one-time price, and a real Black Friday / Cyber Monday discount.
One product per pull request. Hand edits to the README and pull requests with more than one product are closed.
Closed for duplicates, broken links, a missing offer or a missing description.
The pull request template asks for a 'Why it belongs' section and has a box for the six-month rule; no licence box.

Maintainer comment, not a written rule (10 Nov 2026): 'The list is for tools developers use in their own work'; a consumer app was closed on that ground, and AI model resellers and wrappers on another.
status_note: 38 pull requests from outside authors merged since 1 Oct 2026, the latest on 20 Nov 2026; 2 open; 6 closed without a merge.
recommended_for: tools developers and designers pay for, public for six months or more; a consumer app is a weak fit
